A baseline is the schedule's dates kept under a name, so progress can be measured against them. Save one when the contract is signed and another after a re-plan.

A formal record of what was sent, to whom and why
A line starting with # begins a section; every other line is an item. Assign owners and dates on the plan page. Editing the outline keeps the owner, date, note and done state of items whose wording and section are unchanged.
A link lets one contact at an invited company read the documents, acknowledge addenda and send or change a bid, with no account. Links are emailed once the package is out for bid. Bids sent this way stay sealed until bidding closes.
A name already used is replaced. The new baseline becomes the one the chart and each task's slip compare against.

A project admin has full access to every tool, so overrides have no effect.

Export register
Export the schedule from your planning software as an exchange (.xer) file. The work breakdown becomes summary tasks, and tasks, dates (actual, else scheduled, else planned), percent complete, milestones, links with their kind and lag, and date constraints come across; resources, calendars and costs are left behind. If the file holds more than one project, give the id of the one you want (the first is used otherwise). Up to 8 MB.
